# 100.00 USD parked in a USD account, having reached an HKD bank.
#
# The same shape as `money_parked_in_usd_that_reached_a_cad_bank.txt` with a
# third currency in the bank's place: the entry is quoted in HKD, because that
# is the currency the cash arrived in, and the parked split holds the USD the
# invoice is in. The book itself is kept in CAD, so *neither* side of this
# entry is the book's own currency.
#
# That is what makes it worth having. The split states the settlement outright
# — 100.00 USD against a 100.00 USD invoice — so the link needs no rate and is
# accepted. What the entry is quoted in only matters on the way back out, and
# there it is a currency an account may not be kept in.
#
# What this fixture produces: an HKD transaction, `Assets:Bank HKD` +780.00 HKD
# against `Assets:Suspense USD` −100.00 USD valued −780.00 HKD, neither split
# in a lot.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_unlinking_a_linked_transaction.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank HKD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"

2026-03-04 * "Money in, USD parked, HKD bank"
	guid: "ddeeff00112233445566778899aabbcc"
	currency.mnemonic: "HKD"
	Assets:Bank HKD 780.00 HKD
		guid: "eeff00112233445566778899aabbccdd"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "HKD"
	Assets:Suspense USD -100.00 USD
		guid: "ff00112233445566778899aabbccddee"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7.80"
		value: "-780.00"
